Michael Gbeleyi

Creative technologist · Robotics systems engineer · Full-stack developer

London, UK · michaelgbeleyi@gmail.com · Studio: admin@m3xi.com

Download PDF

Profile

Creative Robotics BSc student at University of the Arts London (UAL) and founder of M3XI Studio, specialising in physical computing, autonomous kinematics and expressive human-machine interaction.

Combines full-stack software development (Flutter, Supabase, Stripe) with hardware prototyping (Fusion 360, ROS 2, CoreXY mechanisms, FDM fabrication). Driven by a creative method that explores how embodied robotics and expressive agents dismantle fear and create genuine connection across physical and digital spaces.

BTEC Level 3 Extended Diploma — Creative Media: Game Design & Development. Grade D*DD (Distinction)

About me

I'm a model and performer from London, and I want to train properly in acting and stage direction.

I have done robotic puppetry twice. In July 2026 I controlled a robot dog on stage in a play called ARGOS, at Senate House in London. I performed next to a professional actor, in front of about 250 people.

I study robotics at university and I animate characters, so I pay close attention to how people move. I want to bring that into my acting.

Stage work

ARGOS2026
  • My role: I controlled the robot dog, Argos, live on stage.
  • Where: Senate House, London. It was the closing show of an international robotics conference (ICSR + Art 2026).
  • Director: Prof. George Rodosthenous. Producer: Dr Hooman Samani.
  • The story: Odysseus comes home after 20 years and only his dog recognises him. The dog never speaks, so all of its feeling came from the way I moved it.
  • Watch the trailer
